shots.focal_element: Plush Oscar character standing on a recreated Duolingo course-picker screen between the Chess and German course tiles
shots.transition_other: Detector reports a non-standard transition; the entry from s012 is not visible in this packet
shots.typography: Rounded geometric sans, bold; stat numerals in coloured bold, course labels in dark bold title case, 'ELO PROGRESS' small bold all-caps grey with wide tracking (low-confidence guess: Duolingo's Feather/DIN Rounded family)
shots.what_happens: A flat phone-UI panel on a green field shows the stats bar, a highlighted Chess tile, a German flag tile and the start of an ELO progress chart; a stop-motion plush Oscar stands in front, slightly bobbing and gesturing while the VO says 'become a chess master' (w15-w18).
shots.build_rebuild: Render a centred white phone-width card over a two-tone green background with a stats row, two course tiles and a gridline chart, then composite a cut-out character sprite in front with a soft elliptical drop shadow and a small idle bob loop.

shots.focal_element: Oscar plush dropping onto the first lesson node of the course path
shots.transition_other: Continuous vertical scroll of the UI with motion blur (keyframe shows the course tiles blurred mid-scroll)
shots.typography: Same rounded bold sans; 'SECTION 1,' small all-caps light-green with wide tracking over a white bold sentence-case unit title inside a green banner; text partly occluded by the character
shots.what_happens: In a very short beat the page scrolls up with motion blur from the course picker to the lesson path; Oscar is carried along and lands on a green star lesson node below the 'Section 1' banner as the VO says 'one lesson' (w19-w20).
shots.build_rebuild: Tween the UI layer's translateY upward over roughly 0.4 s with a strong ease-out and directional motion blur, while the character sprite drops onto the first node with a small squash on landing.

shots.focal_element: Oscar hopping down the lesson path past the Duo owl mascot at a chalkboard
shots.transition_other: Continuation of the vertical scroll/camera follow down the lesson path
shots.typography: Unit banner: small all-caps tracked label with chevron over a larger bold white sentence-case title, rounded sans
shots.what_happens: The camera follows Oscar as he steps from node to node down the path; the 'Moving the pieces' unit banner scrolls off the top and Duo the owl appears beside a chalkboard, hands on cheeks, while the VO finishes 'at a time' (w21-w23).
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the character sprite roughly fixed in frame while panning the course-path layer upward, stepping the character between circular 3D-extruded nodes and placing an owl sprite with a chalkboard illustration at the lower right.

shots.composition_other: Asymmetric board edge: green margin left, partial chessboard right, piece near the left column
shots.focal_element: Rook on the chessboard with grey move-hint dots, then a bishop in the board corner
shots.transition_other: Fast move from the lesson path into the in-lesson chessboard view (exact mechanism not resolvable at 2 fps)
shots.what_happens: Starting on Oscar at the path node, the view moves into a light grey checkerboard: a rook sits on the edge file with dots showing its legal straight-line moves, then the frame reveals a board corner where a bishop lands with a dust ring and finally shows its diagonal move dots, synced to 'New to the game? I'll show you the basic moves' (w24-w32).
shots.build_rebuild: Build a flat SVG checkerboard with a green frame, place a rook sprite with soft ellipse shadow and fade in grey hint dots along its file, then cut/pan to a bishop that drops in with a small radial dust burst and pops in diagonal hint dots.

shots.focal_element: Bishop landing on a centre square with a ring of dust particles
shots.transition_other: Detector reports a non-standard transition from s016; appears as a quick reframe to the board corner
shots.what_happens: Brief beat (about 0.46 s) of the bishop settling on a square near the board's top-right corner, small grey dust blobs ringing its base, as the VO says 'basic' (w32).
shots.build_rebuild: Drop a bishop sprite onto a square with a short ease-out and spawn eight small grey ellipses that scale out radially and fade over a few frames.

shots.focal_element: Bishop dust-landing on the board after a motion-blurred vertical whip from the course picker
shots.typography: Course labels in rounded bold sans, heavily motion-blurred and only partly legible
shots.what_happens: The frame opens on a heavily vertically blurred view of the course picker (Chess, French, German tiles) above the board, which snaps down to the board corner where the bishop lands again with its dust ring, on 'moves' (w33).
shots.build_rebuild: Start the shot with a fast vertical translate of a stacked course-picker and board layer under a strong vertical motion blur, decelerating to rest on the board where a bishop sprite lands with a radial dust burst.
